verdict.rationale: BigCommerce's first-party docs describe public REST and GraphQL APIs for managing products, orders, customers, and store settings programmatically. They also cover OAuth-based API accounts with scoped credentials, an in-browser Request Runner in the API Reference, language API clients, and an llms.txt file with instructions for AI agents. One community comment mentions throttling and dropped connections, but it is secondhand hearsay and not a concrete counter-example. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use and its reliability, such as rate-limit behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote:
Use REST and GraphQL APIs to manage products, orders,
customers, and store settings programmatically.
BigCommerce offers three types of OAuth-based API accounts to developers who wish to use BigCommerce's REST APIs: store-level credentials, app-level credentials, and account-level credentials.
You can experiment with our REST Management APIs using the **Request Runner**, which is built in to the [API Reference]
Get started making API requests in the language of your choice with our API Clients.
